title: CI Rollout Record
description: CI observation record for the TypeScript 7 rollout lane. One record per representative CI run. Three consecutive clean runs are required before the TS 7 lane becomes required-blocking (test-strategy.md section 5 Phase 3h).

run_id.description: Real CI run identifier (e.g. GitHub Actions run number). Not fabricated.

ts7_gate_exit.description: Exit status of the TypeScript 7 gate in this run.

ts6_parity_exit.description: Exit status of the TypeScript 6 parity gate in this run.

cache_state.description: Turbo cache state for this run. HIT, MISS, BYPASSED, or the full parsed JSON object.

order_dependent_diff_count.description: Count of order-dependent diagnostic differences observed in this run. Non-zero indicates nondeterminism that must be investigated.

peak_rss_kib.description: Peak resident set size in KiB for the CI run.
